reponse: The most recent figure puts the Q1 payout fee at 0.45%, not 0.40%, after Gil's review. The v3 deck is described as outdated, and the Slack post says tiers are unchanged and customer notices go out by Dec 1 [2]. The earlier v3 proposal, dated Nov 9, had 0.40% per payout (today 0.50%), with a $0.25 minimum, and tiers of −0.05 pt above $5M/month and −0.10 pt above $20M/month. It also said Tradewell keeps its contracted rate until December 2027 [1]. The draft customer notice still says 0.40%, so it conflicts with the update [4]. Pinecrest was told 0.40% during its QBR, and a sales team member said they would correct this with Rob this week [3][2].
